notes.en: Qualified in a real Linux/riscv64 guest: the complete verifier, XLSX/PDF extraction and CSV/TSV/JSON/TXT/PPTX paths passed, with exact dependency identities. Own-closure import denial passed. Encrypted and scanned PDFs were honestly refused and routed to existing native unlock/OCR capabilities. Native DOCX, protected-PDF and OCR execution were not exercised in this component qualification. Tools and capabilities are unchanged.
notes.zh-Hans: 已在真实Linux/riscv64客体中，按精确依赖版本完成完整验证器、XLSX/PDF提取及CSV/TSV/JSON/TXT/PPTX路径，独立依赖闭包检查通过。加密与扫描PDF保留明确拒绝及既有原生解锁/OCR路由。本轮组件鉴定未执行原生DOCX、保护PDF或OCR链路，工具与能力保持不变。

reviewedPythonPackages.purpose: XLSX workbook -> Markdown table extraction (read-only, bounded, cached formula values only); identical to Debian 13 guest package python3-openpyxl (3.1.5+dfsg)

Extractable-text PDF -> Markdown for bounded in-guest/batch workflows; encrypted PDFs are refused and routed to the native PDFKit flow; identical to Debian 13 guest package python3-pdfminer (20221105+dfsg)
